basic_info.description: Incredible Opportunity - Make It Yours! Located on one of the premier blocks of West Portal, 110 Forest Side offers a fantastic opportunity to renovate and create your dream home. With beautiful 1930s craftsmanship and a grand three-level floor plan, this major fixer-upper has incredible upside potential for owner-user or contractor. Close to vibrant West Portal shops, restaurants, cafes, and parks. The main level features a majestic living room with arched ceilings, a stunning stone fireplace, and original parquet hardwood floors that flow into a separate large formal dining room with mahogany doors. The breakfast room/kitchen presents the perfect opportunity to create a spacious, modern chef's kitchen. Two generously sized bedrooms overlook the backyard, accompanied by a large full bath off the hallway. Upstairs, the top floor offers a primary en-suite with plumbing in place for a full bath or the flexibility to create a family room. Roof decks off this level may provide additional opportunities for outdoor living space. The lower level includes bonus room direct to garden, home office with access to a bathroom, laundry room, additional storage, 2 car tandem garage.The spacious backyard is ready to be transformed with thoughtful landscaping and entertaining spaces.
